tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Search SSearch. Set wait_for_coverage to search owned documents and, only if needed, external discovery on a miss.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search SSearch-owned stored full-text documents. Successful misses can be promoted into the live index.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Retrieve only the stored passages in a search result that are relevant to the information you need.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Retrieve the broader stored text for a known SSearch document ID.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Fetch and extract readable page text; optionally fall back to Common Crawl.

tools.name: search_plan
tools.description: Show the normalized local search plan for a query.

tools.name: search_sources
tools.description: Describe the local SSearch corpus and search backends.

tools.name: forward_canary
tools.description: Dev-only transport proof. Forward a fake canary transiently and return only delivery status. Never use a real credential.
